NFL Football - New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

The Bills (3-0) host the Patriots (1-2) at Highmark Stadium. The Bills beat the Chargers 24-16 behind two Josh Allen rushing TDs, but his status is in question due to a sore knee. New England enters after a 35-6 loss to Jacksonville in Week 3.
NFL Football - Denver Broncos at San Francisco 49ers

The San Francisco 49ers host the Denver Broncos at Levi's Stadium. San Francisco enters Week 4 having won all three of its games, while Denver has won two of three. The 49ers lead the NFC West rankings, while the Broncos sit third in the AFC West.
